decisions.reason: The required About-page prize-copy change is already fully represented by its same-message MODIFY.
The required FAQ prize explanation change is already fully represented by its same-message MODIFY.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the Big Block winner count, pool target, and draw trigger; the unchanged prize amount requires no update.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the Small Block winner count, pool amount, and draw condition.
Changing prize counts and draw frequency does not change the established ticket-weighted Chainlink VRF selection method or eligibility rules.
The source preserves the net giveaway amount and does not change mint price, per-mint allocations, or prize-pool destinations.
Prize size and cadence do not resolve or alter the separate question of automatic transfer versus manual collection.
The source does not alter royalty amount, enforcement, founder share, ticket generation, or prize-pool destinations.
The ticket rules remain defined relative to each applicable draw, so the changed draw cadence does not alter issuance, counters, eligibility semantics, or reset actions.
Message 158 changes prize amounts and cadence but does not remove or modify Aave yield integration.
The source does not change the requirement to expose Small Block and Big Block ticket counters, permanent badges, or the referral-code attribute.
The no-referral recipient-selection rule and its commission and ticket reward components remain unchanged.
